theme_and_archetype.vibe: Premium, mystical, authoritative, deeply rooted in Vedic traditions but executed with modern high-end SaaS polish.

rules: Headings must use font-light or font-medium, never font-black.
Overlines/Labels must be uppercase with wide spacing tracking-[0.2em].
No Inter, Roboto, or standard sans-serif for headings.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing (p-8 to p-12 standard). Dashboard must feel like a premium command center.

grids.dashboard: Control Room Mode: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4, tight gaps (gap-6)
grids.marketing: Tetris Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12, wide gaps (gap-12), highly asymmetrical

surfaces.cards: Flat dark maroon backgrounds (#2A0E18) with a 1px solid border (#D4AF37/20).

marketing_hero.visuals: Dark starry background. Overlay max opacity bg-black/50.
marketing_hero.cta: Gold solid button, high contrast black text.

dashboard.structure: Sidebar or top nav with glassmorphism. Main area split into 'Your Matches' and 'High Compatibility'.
dashboard.your_matches_free: Visible cards, clear typography. Ashtakoota gauge out of 36.
dashboard.high_compatibility_paywalled: Cards wrapped in relative container. Content is blurred (blur-md). Overlay with locked icon and 'Unlock 5 connections with ₹1000' CTA.

match_card.style: Neumorphic/Tactile variant but dark. Sharp 1px border. Ashtakoota score prominently displayed with a circular SVG gauge or elegant progress bar.
match_card.interaction: Hover: -translate-y-1, border changes to solid Gold.

kundali_report.style: Editorial print style. High contrast text on dark background. Generous padding.
kundali_report.sections: Score summary, birth details table, Ashtakoota 8-guna breakdown chart (use Shadcn charts or simple elegant HTML progress bars), Mangal dosha section, final verdict.
kundali_report.pdf_button: Prominent sticky bottom or top right CTA.

waiting_room.visuals: Use spinning CSS astrolabe or elegant pulse animation on a zodiac graphic. Text: 'Consulting the stars...'

onboarding_form.style: Multi-step Shadcn forms. Stripped Vercel look. Customized inputs with maroon backgrounds and gold focus rings (focus:ring-[#D4AF37]).
onboarding_form.inputs: Floating labels or very clean, widely spaced labels.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All cards lift slightly. Buttons get a gold shimmer effect.
motion_and_interactions.paywall_unlock: When unlocked, glass pane fades out, blur drops to 0 smoothly, gold particles or flash animation.

icons.style: Duotone or Thin weight for elegance.

images.description: Starry night sky, for the main landing hero section background. Use with heavy dark overlay.
Astrology chart and tarot, use as secondary image in features section.
Gold zodiac necklace, use to evoke luxury and premium membership.
Elegant Indian wedding couple at night. Use for the dashboard empty state or marketing 'success story' area.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: yarn add @phosphor-icons/react framer-motion lucide-react clsx tailwind-merge
Tailwind Config: Add the custom colors (base, surface, primary, etc.) to the tailwind.config.js.
Fonts: Import 'Cormorant Garamond' and 'Outfit' from Google Fonts in index.css.
Shadcn Components: Override default Shadcn radii (use rounded-md or rounded-none) and colors to match the Jewel & Luxury archetype. Strip the Vercel styling.

Paywall Implementation: The high compatibility cards MUST be rendered but obscured using a parent div with 'backdrop-blur-md bg-[#0A0305]/70 absolute inset-0 z-10 flex flex-col items-center justify-center'. The button to unlock must be inside this overlay.
Testing IDs: Ensure all buttons, forms, and the paywall unlock CTA have 'data-testid' attributes (e.g., 'data-testid="unlock-premium-button"').
PDF Generation: Ensure the Kundali report UI is cleanly printable or use a server-side library, but the UI must have a 'data-testid="download-pdf-button"'.
